title: Analyze Page News
directive: can u investigate the news on the page

thoughts.thought:
The screen shows the Google News page in Norwegian ("Google Nyheter"). I need to identify the main news headlines.

I see several headlines under "Hovedoppslag" (Main Stories) and "Lokale nyheter" (Local News), and "Spesielt for deg" (Especially for you).

Some main headlines I can see are:
- "TV 2-trøbbel" (TV 2 trouble)
- "Støre og Stoltenberg sa nei: Nå skal likevel skipstunnelen bygges" (Støre and Stoltenberg said no: Now the ship tunnel will be built anyway)
- "Enige om revidert nasjonalbudsjett" (Agree on revised national budget)

I will scroll down to see if there are more prominent headlines before summarizing.
